**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 (Insurance) meets the INSURANCE rule's **preferred** position on every material term:

| Requirement (preferred) | § 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✅ Exact match |
| Professional E&O USD 2M | ✅ Exact match |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M (Vendor processes Customer Data per §§ 15, 17) | ✅ Exact match |
| Workers' compensation as required by law | ✅ Plus employer's liability USD 1M (extra) |
| Certificates on request | ✅ § 18.2 |

The clause also carries the coverage through the term plus one year afterward, tracking our model language. Clause 18.2 adds several customer-favourable mechanics beyond the playbook ask — reputable insurers, primary to Customer's insurance where commercially customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities (preserving our indemnity and liability rights under §§ 20–21).

No further action needed on this rule.
